hits.evidence: Announced move from Gillette Stadium (NFL) and a Rhode Island venue to the rebuilt White Stadium in Boston; the Massachusetts SJC cleared the project in August 2026, first Legacy match there planned for 2028.

Planned 14,500-seat soccer-specific stadium at Santa Fe Yards in Denver, approved by City Council (Dec 2025) and land acquired (March 2026), replacing a temporary venue in Centennial; opening about 2028-29.

Signed agreement (March 2026) for Avenue Sports Fund, the sports fund of investment firm Avenue Capital (Marc Lasry), to invest $40m at a $155m valuation for a minority stake, pending NWSL approval; not counted in current Ownership.
